# Pinned to exact versions so unattended CI is reproducible — an upstream release
# can't silently break a scheduled crawl. Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) proposes
# controlled bumps via PR. Regenerate after an intentional upgrade with:
#   pip install -U <pkg> && pip freeze | grep -i <pkg>
requests==2.32.5
urllib3==2.6.3          # Retry/backoff used by crawlers/_http.py
pyyaml==6.0.3
python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0
python-dotenv==1.2.2    # loads .env for local development

# YouTube transcript (no API key needed — uses auto-generated captions).
# Unofficial + scrapes YouTube internals, so it breaks often — pin it hard.
youtube-transcript-api==1.2.4

# LLM providers — install only what you use (set via LLM_PROVIDER env var)
openai==2.29.0
anthropic==0.86.0
google-generativeai==0.8.6

# Calendar event parsing (ICS feeds)
icalendar==7.0.3

# Local NLP fallback — used when no LLM API key is set (zero cost, no network)
sumy==0.12.0            # extractive summarization (LSA)
yake==0.7.3             # keyword extraction
nltk==3.9.4             # required by sumy tokenizer

# Semantic embeddings for initiative clustering (Signal 7) — optional but recommended
# Uses ONNX Runtime (no PyTorch needed). Downloads ~33MB model on first use.
fastembed==0.8.0
